steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Let's review all the information we have on Rhodes Island so far.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: First, both Big Bob and the High Priest thought they could help us...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Second, Kay said there's someone called the 'Doctor' who can definitely solve our problem...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: And lastly, it seems we're finally getting close to their ship!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I just hope they really do have a way of solving this...

spans.text: have a way of solving this...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Hey guys, look!
The three head over to the cliff's edge at Chilchuck's cry. It is then they realize why there was a tinge of worry in his voice.
They see a giant, colossal ship.
It sails across the land, a vessel much larger than any seafaring ship they have seen before.
A massive construct of steel. A city. A... dungeon.
This is it. Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: ...My word, a ship that sails on land.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Can we really find a way home there?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I think we've got another problem to deal with first.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: How are we going to get on board?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I can't see any entrances, even from here.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Look! I think there's some people approaching the ship.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Looks like a caravan to me.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: A caravan, huh...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Why don't we go talk to them and see if they can bring us aboard?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: We're back.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Good work out there.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: No problem. Oh, right. We just ran into a party of four looking for help. They're dressed real funny, said they know Ceobe, and were hoping Rhodes Island could help them go home.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Hm? Go home?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: More or less, from what I understand. Would you mind leading the way for them? I'll go talk with Field Operations.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hello!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: If you came to us for aid, you must be looking for the Doctor or Amiya, right?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Err... Kay did mention a 'Doctor,' so they're probably who we're looking for?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Could you set up a meeting for us?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I have to check your identities first. If you could just follow me—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Whoa! Really sorry, dropped my things...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: 'Bob's Gourmet Guide'?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You know Big Bob?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Sure do. He cooked us the first meal we had here.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Aye, anyone who can make such a delicious meal out of such hard bugs is admirable in my eyes.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I see. So you're the 'friends' he mentioned.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I'm Mudrock. Big Bob told me about you. At the time, he had just decided to leave the mercenary life behind, but had no idea whether starting a farm would be viable.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Farms in the wilderness are often targeted by bandits and looters. He didn't have many business connections, and he wasn't sure if the beer he brewed was any good.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But the joy on your faces as you ate his cooking gave him confidence.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I never realized he was in such dire straits.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Is... Is he alright nowadays?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Don't know. We haven't met in a long while.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: All I've heard is that his Originium slug beer factory's doing well and making a profit. Seems he's got it made.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Good, good.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But I also heard that he broke some local laws in the process. Some kind of tax issue. He was sent to jail.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Jail? Are you sure he's still alright?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: The most recent news I heard was that he either broke out or made bail. Either way, he's fine.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I guess that's... good?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: A jailbreak, huh...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I've also heard that he set up a grocery store in Sami. Business is good there, apparently.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: He... knows how to persevere, at least.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Anyway, come with me. We'll head up in the elevator.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: 'Elevator'? You mean this iron box? How do you use it?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Looks like another magic item to me...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Go on inside. We're heading to the first floor. Wait a moment though, I need to get a—

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...Where did they go?

steps.name: Laios's Party
steps.text: Why's everything all different now?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Where are we? What just happened?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: This place is looking more and more like a dungeon by the second.

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: ...As I have foreseen.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Hey, aren't you the Cyclops from Sami?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: A Cyclops?! How do you know—

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Wait. If you're here, that means you saw something, right?

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Then, what did you see?

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: On your road ahead, there will be flames, a great shock... and a fearsome beast.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Do you know where Ceobe or the Doctor are?

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: Ceobe has just returned. She should be at the training room now, which is that way.

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: As for the Doctor... Please forgive me for not being able to tell you anything at the moment.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: So... where should we go first?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I don't think Mudrock will find us any time soon.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: This is the training room the lady from earlier told us about.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Doesn't seem like there's anyone here. There's some great big strange thing over there...

spans.text: Doesn't seem like there's anyone here. There's some great big

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: What are you lot doing here with that gormless look on your faces?!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Eh? High Priest?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Have you seen Ceobe, High Priest?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: She was here a moment ago, but ran off somewhere.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: You guys looking for her?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Don't just stand there then, get your butts over here and sit in this machine!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Huh? Uh... Sure, okay.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: High Priest, did you happen to see some lost visitors? We heard they were spotted around here.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: What? No, I haven't. We're about to run an impact safety test on this new model of Big Ugly.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: I suggest you stand back a bit.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Uh... Sure.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Alright, Zumama, everything's ready to go!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Of course I'm sure.

steps.name: Cockpit-Encased Laios's Party
steps.text: AAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH—!

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Was it just me or were there people inside that thing when it got blasted?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Are you sure about that? Did you see anyone get blasted?

spans.text: Are you sure about that? Did you

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Oh, huh... Guess not?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Just my imagination, then.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Yeah, yeah, go look somewhere else. The ones you're looking for aren't here.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Sure. Thanks.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I think this is what they call an 'abuse of power.'

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: They put me in a stew one time, I blew them up one time. Fair's fair.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Where'd you send them?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: They wanted to find Ceobe, so I sent them to her.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: That part's no lie.
The smoke from the explosion clears, and the four find themselves experiencing the oddly-familiar feeling of floating in midair. As they regain their senses, gravity begins to do its work.
Surprisingly, it is P'o-shan Village rushing up to meet them. Dawn watches them with a peculiar expression on her face.

steps.name: Laios's Party
steps.text: AHHHHHHH!!! HELP US—
The four flail about in the air, to no avail.
However, it does not escape their notice that below them is not solid ground, but a near-infinitely deep well.
Instead of a cold, hard, and most-likely-fatal landing, they find themselves shooting straight into their hole of hope.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: ...A tad crude, but I guess that's how she will send them on their way.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: May we meet again someday.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Did Kay run into the kitchen again?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: That she has.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: But she's been acting oddly this time around.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: How so?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: She's been unusually silent since her return.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll go have a chat with her, then.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Kay.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you alright? Do you feel unwell?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Uhh... Dunno know how to describe it...

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I've been feeling weird ever since I got back to the ship...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If that's the case, why don't we go to Medical together and let the doctors have a look?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: ...Don't wanna.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I dunno why, but I feel like... I should wait here by myself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh. Alright then. Go get some rest, okay?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Oww... My butt...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: We're in... a kitchen?

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: Who are you?!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Get behind me, Amiya!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Be careful, everyone!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Looks like High Priest sent us somewhere where they're not too friendly.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: High Priest? Who are you—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What was that?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It came from the room Kay's resting in!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's go take a look, quick!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: They mentioned Kay, we should follow them!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What... What in the world?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is that you, Kay?

steps.name: Ceobe?
steps.text: My tummy...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: What is going on here? Is this really the Kay we know?

steps.name: Ceobe?
steps.text: Grr...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can tell from her emotions that she's still Kay, the one we all know and love.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She's still holding on, but she's about to lose control!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Is... Is this really Kay?

steps.name: Ceobe?
steps.text: (Howls)

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: What a handsome hound! I didn't know you could do this kind of thing, Kay!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Is this really the time for that?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: We need to get her to her senses!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Guests.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Based on what you just said, I suppose you came out of concern for Kay's condition, correct?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Well, we came because we wanted to find a way back to our world... but we're still really worried for her!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then let's save the questions for later and get her under control together!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If we can't, then I'm afraid things will get far, far out of hand.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Laios?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Sure. We'll work together, for now.
